provenance: MANUAL observations. Seeds were read visually from the decoded frames (and, for AR/PR corners, from a Hough-style scan of the sharpest frame) BEFORE any 3D result existed. Everything else (exact edge positions, line fits) is computed automatically from these seeds. No ground-truth dimension was used.
image_space: frames undistorted with Recipe A intrinsics (cv2.undistort, newCameraMatrix=K), pixel coordinates (x right, y down), 2160x3840
seed_model: vertical seeds: x = c0 + slope*(y - ref); horizontal seeds: y = c0 + slope*(x - ref); the search window is +-half px around the seed; sign = expected sign of the intensity gradient across the edge

methods.edge_pts: gradient-peak search (sub-pixel parabola) every 6 px along span, 9-px averaging band
methods.track2: two-pass tracking: half-window 10 px around the seed, refit, then half-window 5 px around the fit (25-px averaging band, gradient threshold 0.4)
methods.track_ceilS: tracking every 4 px, half-window 14, 5-px band, threshold 0.8

carpet_edge_windows.purpose: OPTIONAL view-2 floor-contact diagnostic (automatic carpet-edge detection inside these manually chosen windows). The diagnostic intersects rays with a floor plane at the MEASURED lens height, so it is validation-only and never feeds the estimate.

geometric_assumptions: The Air cannot see the ceiling corners: top corners are inferred from the Pro camera rays only.
One bottom corner is obstructed: bottom corners come from the stereo-derived vertical line meeting the floor plane, not from a visible floor contact.
The wall-corner edge is vertical (perpendicular to the reconstructed floor plane).
Top corner = point on that vertical closest to the Pro ray through the ceiling-line intersection in the image.
